verses.text: Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal, ay jun tas ix ak'ji swayichej winh. Ix te och winh ilk'olal yuj jun swayich chi', yuj chi' majxo ochlaj swayanh winh.

Haxo masanil heb' winh syal yuj yalani, heb' winh ajb'aal, heb' winh jelan yet' heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal, ix chekji awtajkot heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', yik tzul yal heb' winh tas syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'. Haxo yik ix jawi heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ix in wayichej, te ilk'olal waj yuj. Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh t'a ti' arameo icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab'nhej opisio tik t'a junelnhej. Al t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik tas ix a wayichej chi', ol kalan t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Toxo ix in na'a, tato manh ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, chok' ol ex aj he xikjichamok, haxo he pat, ol pojchajkanemok.

Palta tato ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, niwan silab' ol wak' spakok t'ayex, te niwan pax ol aj eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi', alek t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh jelan chi' t'a schaelal icha tik: --Mamin rey, al a wayich chi' t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik yik ol kal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Wojtakxo to tonhej tze say modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a, yuj chi' tzeyik'ek' tiempo, yujto eyojtak to a tas ix wal t'a he patik manh ol ek'laj.

Tato manh ol eyala' tas ix in wayichej chi', a tas nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ujok, yujto ix he mol alej tas tzeyutej he pakan t'ayin t'a esal, yakb'an wan he tanhwan in k'exan tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Alek tas ix in wayichej chi', yik snachajel wuuj to ol yal eyalani tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wixi heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj junok anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik syal snachajel yuj tas tza k'anb'ej tik. Hanhejtona', malaj junok rey wach'chom te b'inajnak sk'anb'an icha jun tik t'a heb' winh jelan.
Yujto a jun tik, te ajaltak snachajeli. Malaj junok mach syal yalani, anhej am heb' Dios snachaj yuj, palta a heb' chi', manhok t'a ko kal ay heb' a onh anima onh tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il. Ix yalan winh to xikjicham heb' winh jelan chi' t'a masanil yol yik Babilonia.
Ayik ix elta jun ley chi', ix saychajek' winhaj Daniel yet' heb' winh oxwanh yetb'eyum winh, yik schampax heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Arioc, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey. Ix ak'jioch yopisio winh yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan chi'. Wan smolb'aj heb' winh yuj winh, haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix lolon yet' winh t'a jelanil yet' t'a emnakilal.
Ix sk'anb'an yab' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj elanhchamel ix yak'elta jun ley te ow tik winh rey chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc tas yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Daniel yik stewi winh t'a winh rey yik tz'ak'ji jab'okxo stiempo winh, yik syalan winh tas syalelk'och jun wayich chi'. Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj Daniel chi' t'a spat. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum, haton winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías, chajtil yaj jun lolonel chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to sk'an skolwal sDiosal satchanh heb' winh yik snachajel jun lolonel satub'tak chi' yuj heb' winh, yik max miljicham heb' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh jelan t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' Dios swayichej winhaj Daniel tas jun swayich winh rey chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach ko Diosal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ik yaj masanil jelanil yet' poder.
Ha ach ojtak jantak tiempo syak' yajalil junjun mach, yujto a ach tzak'och heb' t'a yopisio. Hanheja' a ach syal ik'anxiel heb'. Uuj ay spensar heb' ay spensar. Uuj ay sjelanil heb' jelan.
Ha ach tzak' ojtakajel tas satub'tak yet' tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Ojtak masanil tastak ay t'a kal k'ik' k'inal, yujto aj sakil k'inal ach.

Ach ko Diosal, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam kicham, skak' yuj diosal t'ayach. Skalanpax wach' lolonel, yujto ix ak' in jelanil yet' in tek'anil. Ha tiknaik, ix ak' wojtakejeli tas ix ko k'an t'ayach. Ix ak' kojtakejeli tas yaj swayich winh rey, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi winhaj Daniel chi', ix b'at winh t'a winhaj Arioc, haton winh ix ak'ji yopisio yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a milcham heb' winh jelan chi'. Ik' in b'at t'a yichanh winh rey. Ol wala' tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ik'chajb'at winh yuj winhaj Arioc chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Judá, ix ilchaj jun winh winak wuuj. Ha winh ol alanok tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Daniel chi', skuchanpax Beltsasar, icha tik: --¿Ol am yal halani tas ix in wayichej chi', tas pax syalelk'ochi? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a jun tas satub'tak tza nib'ej tzojtakejel chi', wach'chom a heb' winh jelan, heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' winh ajb'aal, malaj junok heb' winh snachajel yuj.
Palta ay jun Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, ha' syal yak'an kojtakejel tas satub'tak. Ha ix ak'an ojtakejeli tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas ix a wayichej chi'.
Ach Mamin rey, ayik jichan ach ek' t'a sat ch'at, wan a naani tastak ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh, haxo Dios, haton tz'ak'an ojtakajel tas satub'tak, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach.
Hanheja' pax ix ch'oxan jun tik t'ayin, manh yujok to te jelan in t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, maay, palta yuj wak'an ojtakejeli tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', yik ol nachajel uuj tas tza na'a.
Mamin rey, a tas ix il t'a a wayich chi' to ay jun yechel anima te niwan, linhanek' t'a ichanh. Weei yilji, te ay smay yilji.
Ha sjolom, nab'a oro. Haxo snhi' sk'ool yet' sk'ab', nab'a plata. Haxo sk'ool yet' yib'tak xub', nab'a bronke.
Haxo xub' yet' spenek, nab'a hierro, haxo samil yok yet' yiximal yok, a k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a kal k'ak'.

Mamin rey, yakb'an wan ilan jun chi', ay jun k'een k'een munil ix kot t'a sat witz, malaj mach ix ekankot k'een. Ha wal t'a yok jun yechel chi' b'aj kalan yaj k'een hierro yet' lum lum, hata' ix och tanhnaj k'een.

nhej wal chi' ix pojb'at k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', k'een bronke, k'een plata yet' k'een oro chi', pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'ati. Icha wal smatz'il ixim trigo b'aj stek'chaj t'a waresma tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', manhxa jab'ok skani, icha chi' ix ajkanb'at jun yechel chi'. Haxo k'een k'een ix mak'anpoj jun yechel chi', ix q'uib'chaanh k'een. Icha lum niwak witz ix aj k'een, ix makchajel yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj k'een.
Mamin rey, haton jun tik ix a wayichej. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha ach tik, sat aj t'a masanil heb' rey, yujto ha Dios aj satcha'anh, ha' ix ach ak'anoch reyal. Ix yak'anpax a jelanil yet' a b'inajnakil yet' sniwanil elk'ochi.

Ix ach yak'och yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil lum lum b'aj kajan heb' anima, nok' nok' yet' nok' much. Ha Dios chi' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yol a k'ab', yuj chi' a ach ton tzach sch'ox sjolom jun yechel to nab'a oro ix il chi'.

Ayik ol lajwokek' opisio tik, ol k'e waan junxo nakión, palta manh lajanoklaj yet' jun ik tik. Slajwi chi', ol k'e waan junxo yoxil, haton jun sch'ox k'een bronke chi'. Haton jun chi' ol ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol k'e waan junxo schanhil te ay yip, icha k'een hierro. Ha k'een hierro chi' smak'an poj masanil tastak, pokok tz'aj yuj k'een. Icha chi' ol aj junxo ol k'e waan chi', ol satjokel juntzanhxo nakión yuj.

Ix ilanpax yok yet' yiximal yok jun yechel chi', kalan yaj k'een hierro chi' yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a skal k'ak'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a jun nakión chi' cha makan yaji: Jun makan ay jab'ok yip icha k'een hierro, icha ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum chi'.
Ha yiximal yok kalan yaj yet' k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', a jun chi', syalelk'ochi to a jun nakión chi' ay jab'ok yip, haxo nanhalxo malaj wal yip.

Icha wal ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yet' lum lum chi', icha chi' ol yutej sb'a heb' yajal t'a juntzanh nakión chi'. Ol laj yik'laj sb'a yal yuninal heb' yik junnhej ol yutok sb'a heb' yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj tas sna heb' chi', icha k'een hierro max skalej sb'a yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a stiempoal juntzanh heb' yajal chi', hata' ol k'e waan junxo nakión yuj Dios aj satcha'anh, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satelok, manhxo ol kan t'a yalanh junokxo. Ol satjokel juntzanhxo nakión chi' yuj, ol kannhej t'a junelnhej.

Haton chi' syalelk'och k'een k'een ix il skot t'a sat witz to malaj junok mach ix ekankoti. Haton yuj k'een pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'at k'een hierro, k'een bronke, lum lum, k'een plata yet' k'een oro. Mamin rey, ha Dios te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh chi'. Ha jun a wayich chi' te yel, icha wal tz'aj walan tik, icha chi' ol aj yelk'ochi, xchi winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh winhaj Daniel chi', ichato chi' ix schekan winh ak'chaj silab' yet' inkienso t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Wal yel a he Diosal a ex tik, anhej yelxo niwan t'a yichanh juntzanhxo Dios. Haton wal yajalil heb' rey, a sch'oxanpax tas satub'tak yaji. Tik wal a achnhej ix nachajel jun lolonel tik uuj, xchi winh.

Haxo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a jun opisio te niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ak'chajpax silab' te wach' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix ak'chajoch winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'. Ix ochpax winh yajalil t'a masanil heb' winh jelan t'a smakb'en chi'.

Ix sk'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'. Ix schaan sk'ol winh rey chi', ix och heb' winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi', haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ha t'a sdespacho winh rey chi' ayoch winh t'a yopisio.
